(pedestrian) walked into unit 1 while driving through the parking lot. unit 1 driver said unit 2 hit unit 1 with a bag of groceries. i then made contact with unit 2 who stated exited the store and was walking in the parking lot towards her vehicle when suddenly unit 1 drove in front of unit 2 and did not stop causing the front left bumper of unit 1 making contact with unit 2's right hand and right leg. unit 2 did not have any visible injuries and refused medical attention from ems. i then made contact with w1 (store manager) who provided me with video footage of the incident. on the video, i observed unit 2 exiting the store and walking in the parking lot in front of the store holding a couple of grocery bags, i then saw unit 1 driving by in front of unit 2 nearly making contact with unit 2. i saw unit 2 swing her left hand towards unit 1 causing the grocery bad that she was carrying on her left hand making contact with the driver side door of unit 1. i then saw unit 1 driver immediately attempted to open the driver side door but did not put did not put unit 1 in park which caused unit 1 [roadway] forward and unit 2 also continued walking towards the front of unit 1 which resulted in the front left bumper of unit 1 making contact with unit 2's right hand and right leg, then unit 1 driver immediately put unit 1 in park. i did not observe unit 1 driver intentionally attempted to make contact with unit 2. traffic investigations detective h. gurrola #2631 was contacted and informed of this accident with pedestrian involved. detective gurrola instructed me that i did not have an offense only an accident crash report and advised me that unit 1 did not yield the right away to a pedestrian. unit 1 driver and unit 2 were advised it was just an accident crash report then were provided with this [case id] for insurance purpose. bwc / fleet available

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 had one operator and one front right passenger. unit 1 was a garbage truck that was done with its route and empty. unit 1 operator and passenger noticed a hanging piece of debris hanging from the rear of the garbage truck. unit 1 pulled over and the passenger exitted the truck and removed the debris. unit 1 stated he lost sight of the passenger via mirror and then placed the air brake on to exit the truck and assist the passenger. unit 1 operator stated he observed the passenger near the rear left wheels and stated the truck was crushing him. unit 1 operator stated he did not observe anything to be touching the passenger but entered the truck and moved it. ems was contacted. unit 1 operator observed the passenger to stand up and walk around. responding deputies observed the passenger to be alert and did not observe any markings on the passenger that were consistant with being ran over. upon inspection of the truck it did not appear that the passenger was ran over based on the lack of roadway evidence. it was thought by the operator that the air brakes caused the truck to move an inch pinching the passenger who was near the wheels picking up another piece of debris that was observed to be stuck to the rear axle of the truck.

records.deidentified_narrative: the incident occurred at market square in the eldridge shopping center, located at 2700 [roadway]. unit #1 was traveling northbound in front of the target parking lot. person #1 and person #2 were crossing the area, attempting to enter through the south side entrance. unit #1 was moving at a high rate of speed without its headlights or windshield wipers on. just a few steps into crossing the parking lot, person #1 and person #2 were struck by unit #1. unit #1 hit person #1 on the left side of his body, and person #2 was run over by the vehicle's front right tire. person #1 stated that after being struck, the impact was so forceful that it caused him to flip halfway backward. person #2 stated that after person #1 was hit, she was run over by the front right tire of unit #1. person #1 and person #2 were transported by community fire 92 to [medical facility] katy, located at 23900 katy fwy, katy, tx 77494. after the deputies followed up with person #1 and person #[medical facility], i did not observe any scratches or bruises on person #1 at the time of the follow-up. i observed a small scratch on the left foot of person #2, less than an inch in size [medical facility], he was informed there was no broken bones or fractures. upon further investigation, deputies reviewed footage from target's security cameras and observed that unit #1 was traveling without its headlights on. deputies were able to file charges against unit #1 for accepted 2x charges for class a misdemeanor motor vehicle collision [roadway] user within area of crosswalk (tex. transp. code § 545. 428). deputies were able to book unit #1 [roadway] jail, located at [roadway] #1, houston, tx 77084, in good health. the airbags in unit #1's vehicle did not deploy, and the vehicle was towed from the scene. for detailed information, please look at the law report.

records.public_safe_text: the incident occurred at market square in the eldridge shopping center, located at 2700 [roadway]. unit #1 was traveling northbound in front of the target parking lot. person #1 and person #2 were crossing the area, attempting to enter through the south side entrance. unit #1 was moving at a high rate of speed without its headlights or windshield wipers on. just a few steps into crossing the parking lot, person #1 and person #2 were struck by unit #1. unit #1 hit person #1 on the left side of his body, and person #2 was run over by the vehicle's front right tire. person #1 stated that after being struck, the impact was so forceful that it caused him to flip halfway backward. person #2 stated that after person #1 was hit, she was run over by the front right tire of unit #1. person #1 and person #2 were transported by community fire 92 to [medical facility] katy, located at 23900 katy fwy, katy, tx 77494. after the deputies followed up with person #1 and person #[medical facility], i did not observe any scratches or bruises on person #1 at the time of the follow-up. i observed a small scratch on the left foot of person #2, less than an inch in size [medical facility], he was informed there was no broken bones or fractures. upon further investigation, deputies reviewed footage from target's security cameras and observed that unit #1 was traveling without its headlights on. deputies were able to file charges against unit #1 for accepted 2x charges for class a misdemeanor motor vehicle collision [roadway] user within area of crosswalk (tex. transp. code § 545. 428). deputies were able to book unit #1 [roadway] jail, located at [roadway] #1, houston, tx 77084, in good health. the airbags in unit #1's vehicle did not deploy, and the vehicle was towed from the scene. for detailed information, please look at the law report.
